episodes.synopsis: Dr. Saotome recruits the first Getter pilot a young martial artist by the name of Ryoma Nagare.
episodes.title: Ryoma Joins

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Saotome and Ryoma atempt to recruit the second Getter pilot Hayato Jin the leader of a criminal gang.
episodes.title: Hayato is Coming

episodes.synopsis: The Oni attack monastery leaving oly one survivor a monk named Benkei Musashibou. Dr. Saotome belives Benkei to be the third Getter pilot.
episodes.title: Benkei Musashibou

episodes.synopsis: Ryoma, Hayato and Benkei clash over Ryoma's attatude and reckless behaviour.
episodes.title: Three Animals Go!

episodes.synopsis: Ryoma tired of waiting to be attacked decides to follow an escaping Oni to find where they are coming from, meanwhile an archaeological dig turns up the skulls of dead Oni.
episodes.title: Oni Fire

episodes.synopsis: The Getter and it's three pilots are seperated and sent to an altered past where the humans and Oni are at war.
episodes.title: The Mansion Where the Oni Dwell

episodes.synopsis: Still in the past Hayato and Benkei are reunited with the Getter. Ryoma attacks the Oni mansion.
episodes.title: The Ying-Yang Master

episodes.synopsis: The Getter and the human army storm the Oni City, Ryoma goes after Seimei.
episodes.title: Collision

episodes.synopsis: After returning home the Getter is upgraded and Ryoma gets a glimpse of a terrible future.
episodes.title: Hell's Upheaval

episodes.synopsis: After his vision of the future Ryoma leaves as Seimei returns to once again battle the Getter.
episodes.title: Lone Wolf

episodes.synopsis: Benkei attempts to destroy the Getter leading to a fight with Ryoma. Hayato learns more about the getter rays.
episodes.title: Thus the Divine Wind Blows

episodes.synopsis: "Gods" arrive on earth to battle the Getter, the prototype Getters begin to act alone without pilots.
episodes.title: Heaven and Earth

episodes.synopsis: The three pilots begin to fuse to the Getter as they battle with the "Gods".
episodes.title: There Goes Ryoma
